theme: Light theme preferred for Health/HR context, with Dark Mode support
archetype: Organic & Earthy (Trust, Growth, Calm) optimized for Pharmacy SaaS

typography.body: Figtree (Clean, excellent for dense data in dashboards)
typography.rules: H1 max text-5xl to text-6xl. Use tracking-tight for headings >32px. Use tracking-[0.2em] uppercase for overlines and small labels. Never use Inter for headings.

colors.rules: No pure black (#000000) or pure gray. Always tint grays with cool (blue) or warm (orange) undertones. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for normal text.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neumorphism (Tactile) for dashboard cards: flat background, sharp 1px border (border-slate-200), no shadow on default, subtle lift on hover.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 for sticky headers. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.
visual_enhancers.borders: Grid borders (The 'Technical' Look) for dense data tables to expose the skeleton.

component_name.marketing: Native HTML + Tailwind for asymmetrical layouts. Avoid rigid Shadcn wrappers for landing pages.
component_name.dashboard: Shadcn UI (Tables, Calendars, Dialogs, Select, Dropdowns). Go cardless or use max 8px radius.
component_name.chat_widget: Floating bottom-right ChatWidget. Must use Glassmorphism to feel premium.
component_name.forms: Strictly use Shadcn Form elements. No native <input> or <select>.

grids.marketing_landing: The 'Tetris' Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, gap-8 to gap-12). Force asymmetry for the 3 main action cards.
grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4, gap-4 or gap-6). North Star metric top-left. Subgrid for alignment.

layouts.general: Optical alignment over geometrical. Mobile-first responsive grids.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-8, p-12). Dashboard needs high density but clear hierarchy.

motion.rules: Micro-interactions on all hover/active states. Staggered entrance animations for lists.
motion.technical: Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform). NEVER use 'transition: all'.

accessibility.contrast: Text over images MUST use overlays (max bg-black/50) or text shadows to pass APCA/WCAG.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus states required (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500).

media.hero_overlay: For hero images, use bg-black/30 to bg-black/50 or gradients to ensure text readability without killing the image.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not highly recommended for a medical HR dashboard, but Framer Motion can be used for smooth page transitions and ChatWidget interactions. Recharts for HR data visualization.

landing_hero.description: Female pharmacist in a lab coat in a modern pharmacy. Use as the main hero background on the landing page.

career_portal.description: Pharmacy team professionals. Use in the 'Portail Carrières' public portal to showcase culture.

agency_portal.description: Abstract medical pattern. Use as a subtle textured background for the Login or 'Portail Agence' auth pages.

instructions_to_main_agent: Interface MUST be 100% in French as requested by the user.
Use .js/.jsx files exclusively (no .tsx), but follow standard React component patterns.
Build the Landing Page with 3 distinct action cards: Espace Employés, Portail Carrières, Portail Agence.

Implement a robust Admin Sidebar with 13 specific modules: Tableau de bord, Horaires, Recrutement, Paie, Dossiers Employés, Remplacements, Vacances, Performance, Onboarding, Contrats, Avantages sociaux, FAQ, Superadmin.
NEVER use generic AI emojis (🤖, 💡). Use professional Lucide icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic. DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Ensure custom micro-interactions on every clickable element. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns if content scrolls behind them. Always add data-testid to interactive elements. Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
